items.text: ETR weekend summary: Puka GTD/optimism; Breece GTD/pessimism; Saquon expected; Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell/Sampson IN; Lamar/DeVonta/Wicks OUT. Earlier dump had Evans/Deebo/Adams/Rice/Love/Montgomery/Egbuka/Warren/Charbonnet/BRob OUT; Jacobs/Judkins/Addison IN.
items.why: Full weekend reports compiled; changes from Q to OUT/IN tracked.
items.implication: Direct opps for INs; reverse beneficiaries for unexpected INs; key DFS pivots.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for OUTs (e.g. backups behind Montgomery/Egbuka/Warren/BRob); Puka/Jacobs volume.

items.text: Early inactives/activations confirmed: Lamar/Evans/Deebo/BRob etc OUT; Jacobs/Mason/Dell/Kirk/Coleman expected active. Paris game and 1pm lists rolling.
items.why: Official lists and Schefter activations post.
items.implication: Final locks for early games; beneficiaries locked in.

items.text: Rams optimistic Puka Nacua (calf, Q) will play vs Raiders. Felt better Saturday; 'as long as no setbacks, feel good about him available.'
items.why: Improved Saturday after DNP Friday; sources confident barring setback.
items.implication: Puka likely WR1 volume with Adams out; high priority monitor to inactive window.
items.opportunity: Primary target share if active; DFS crucial.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) unlikely to play today vs MIA after missing three games. May work out but not full participant yet; bit early.
items.why: Quad strain; limited participation, sources pessimistic on return today.
items.implication: NYJ backfield to others; monitor final inactive.

items.text: Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; third straight miss. Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; limited all week then downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: Ravens offense limited; Huntley start impacts BAL skill players and CIN matchup.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (hamstring, Q) expected to play Monday vs DAL.
items.why: Returned to practice; ETR and sources optimistic for MNF.
items.implication: Lead RB role if active; major volume return after multi-week absence.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/early-down work; reverse any handcuff starts.

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role for Giants vs Texans (zero touches prior week).
items.why: Sources confirm return to lead RB duties.
items.opportunity: Snap share expansion, early-down and possible RZ work.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs; expected to play Sunday at DET in season debut after exempt list.
items.why: Activated from commissioner's exempt; sources confirm expected to play.
items.implication: Immediate lead/committee RB role possible; monitor snap share vs DET.
items.opportunity: Carries/goal-line; high waiver/ROS upside if workload solid.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) for MNF vs DAL.
items.why: Hamstring for Smith; ankle for Wicks; official Saturday ruling.
items.implication: PHI WR corps thinned; targets to others including possible TE elevation.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining WRs/TEs like Goedert.

items.text: Lamar/Puka/Breece statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate. Sneaky scratches: BRob, Warren, Egbuka (and Jordan). Tempted by CMC slot usage amid 49ers WR outs despite usual skepticism on RB-as-WR.
items.why: Player-specific: early news hope; non-obvious outs impact; CMC smile on slot question with WR injuries.
items.implication: Pivot lineups on these; CMC upside spike if more receiving work.
items.opportunity: CMC routes/targets expansion; backup RBs/WRs behind scratches.
items.conflict: Rarely buys RB-WR claims but tempted here by dire SF WR room.

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel OUT for 49ers; Davante Adams OUT for Rams.
items.why: Official designations in ETR dump; confirmed across reports.
items.implication: SF/LAR WR rooms depleted; Puka (if active) and remaining targets spike; CMC more involved.
items.opportunity: Target concentration to Puka/Kirk (IN)/CMC; SF TE/other WRs.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, David Montgomery, Jeremiyah Love, Brian Robinson, Rashee Rice, Zach Charbonnet OUT per ETR.
items.why: Saturday night full dump matching beat/Schefter.
items.implication: Clear handcuff/backup elevations; IND TE void, HOU RB, TB WR, etc.

items.text: All ETR projections updated to reflect latest news (Lamar out, Puka optimism, etc).
items.why: Direct response to status summary post.

items.text: Lamar Jackson was close to playing this week, should next week. Rams confident on Puka; Baker Mayfield returns; Skattebo lead; Jacobs returns.
items.why: Insiders show notes; close but OUT this week for Lamar.
items.implication: ROS optimism for Lamar return W8; confirms other statuses.

items.text: Jonah Coleman will be the Broncos RB you wish you had by year end. Roster in 100% of leagues; go fix that. (Top-10 overall ranks also posted.)
items.why: Preseason call reiterated; volume/role trajectory points to must-roster.
items.implication: Immediate add if available; strong ROS handcuff/lead potential (activated/expected).
items.opportunity: RB committee share growth in DEN.
